Platform Engineer (Remote, APAC)
Tidewater Freight

FICTIONAL job post for tests.

Tidewater Freight moves containers between 40 ports in Asia and Oceania. Our booking and tracking platform runs on AWS, and a small platform team of four keeps it fast, cheap and boring. We are hiring a Platform Engineer to own our Kubernetes clusters and the paved road our 30 product engineers use to ship.

What you will do
- Run and upgrade our EKS clusters and the Helm charts every service deploys with.
- Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform, including networking, IAM and RDS for PostgreSQL.
- Build CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions so a merge reaches production in under ten minutes.
- Improve observability with Prometheus and Grafana, and own the alerts that page us.
- Help product teams containerize services with Docker and tune them for cost.

What we need
- 4+ years in platform, infrastructure or backend roles.
- Hands-on Kubernetes in production.
- Terraform and AWS experience (EKS, RDS, IAM, VPC).
- Comfortable writing tooling in Go or Python.
- Experience with Linux and networking basics.

Nice to have
- Experience with Kafka or other event streaming.
- AWS certification.
- Experience joining an on-call rotation.

We pay $70,000 to $95,000 USD a year. Fully remote within UTC+5 to UTC+10.
